# RollSync

RollSync is a complete smart college ERP platform with AI-powered attendance, timetable management, and seamless communication.

## Key Features
- Smart Attendance: Dual-verification using BLE and RFID for automated, accurate roll calls.
- Real-time Timetables: Dynamic class scheduling with instant notifications for room changes and substitutions.
- Advanced Analytics: Comprehensive dashboards providing actionable insights for admins, teachers, and students.
- Cloud-Based Architecture: Secure, high-performance platform accessible from anywhere.

## Modules
- Admin Dashboard
- Teacher Portal
- Student Portal
